# Horkos

> Escrow for purchases made by AI agents on NEAR testnet. Each order locks its price in a contract as an NFT receipt; the seller is paid only if the owner's on-chain mandate allows the order and a verifier in NEAR OutLayer's TEE confirms the delivery matches the listing's JSON Schema; otherwise the order is refunded after its deadline. On the v2 contract the receipt can be passed on, and the data or the refund goes to its holder. Testnet only.

Start with JUDGES.md and CLAIMS.md. Run `npm run judge` in the repository (no keys). The MCP server is `npx -y horkos-mcp`.

## An NFT that holds money and carries the claim

- It holds the order's money: 5 tUSDC stays locked until the delivery is checked. [Live receipts](https://horkos-escrow.netlify.app/explorer.html#receipts)
- Pass it on and the claim moves with it: the refund goes to whoever holds it. [Transfer](https://testnet.nearblocks.io/txns/CLQE8n9UKcBv9jRB1W1ukFXTfrQ7DfmL6Wq6z5G61f4w), [refund to the new holder](https://testnet.nearblocks.io/txns/4NFBbMtoh9cmkm8HoWW8b1ty41GcB3A3yoL4KWF66tti)
- The new holder opens the data, the original buyer can't. [Settlement](https://testnet.nearblocks.io/txns/C1BTBTksm2foRkPWLzuKKeNqfJi5Kz2fgH3474uGN8FS), [v2 receipts](https://horkos-escrow.netlify.app/explorer.html?contract=v2#receipts)
